sloka: स्त्रीषु शूर विनाथासु परदाराभिमर्शक ।कृत्वा कापुरुषं कर्म शूरो ऽहमिति मन्यसे ।। ६.१०५.१३ ।।
transliteration: strīṣu śūra vināthāsu paradārābhimarśaka ।kṛtvā kāpuruṣaṁ karma śūro 'hamiti manyase ।। 6.105.13 ।।

translations.english: "Timid fellow! You having laid hands on another woman think you are a hero? You, who have done such an action, think that you are a hero?"
